ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: Customer shall have no obligation not to solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for 12 months afterward, whether the employee responds to a general advertisement or applies unsolicited.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have turned off the one-way covenant in 12.4 rather than leaving it operative: our position is no non-solicit on Customer, and this is consistent with Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment. If Vendor needs protection, we can discuss a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and no no-hire element.
input.summary: Neutralise the one-way no-hire in §12.4 so no non-solicit binds Customer
